items.why: the hashed copies of the registered probes and scorers (census, rot, simrot, tocard, analyse, startprobe, chain lists); the README's sha256 table names these files
v1 Chrome census 375/430/768 and the 768 card: the first scored census (v1 overlay), where the registered rule gave a MORE (rAF at near y 2500, 0/0 vs 3/4) that led to v2
MISSING at write time (not found in the main checkout or any worktree): the post-registration Chrome census at 430 and 375 that the aggregation rule scores (README names ic2/)
v2 Chrome census 430/430r: the MORE at far y 2796 (rAF 0/0 vs 4/4, code calls 17/17 vs 20/20; main frames 34/34 vs 13/13) that led to v3
v3 Chrome census 430/430r: no MORE; far y 2796 rAF and code calls SAME, main frames 31 to 13, layouts 4 to 0, paints 37/36 to 3/0
v4 Chrome census 430/430r and cards: no MORE, far y 2796 main frames 31/32 to 17/17, layouts 4 to 0, paints 34/39 to 0/3; 430r all SAME; mgmt-ops-10 reproduced byte for byte
start-frame table of the clock-animation forms (Chrome F0/F1, Simulator offsets, cost of 3 plays per 3 s) that chose the 1 ms clock in v4
v3 Chrome 430 identity: analysis shows 6 of 27 slides matching neither F1 nor F2 (one frame ahead), smooth-40 differing by 427 px (max delta 5), A/A 0
v4 Chrome identity at 430, 375, 1024: 0 mismatches, 27 slides (F1 24, F2 2, both 1), all 20 frozen shots 0/0 at 430; the 1024 pixel view (10507/62) and the T2 scores rest on these records and shots
v4 Simulator identity: records, replays, analysis-s4.json, and the rest shot miss (5131 device px, max channel delta 49, A/A 0/0; only the 4th avatar), with crop and diff pictures
t2score outputs and unmasked re-scores of the existing v4 legs (Sim sim4, Chrome 1024/430/375) quoted in the P-089 score tables
P-089 chain logs, per-leg coverage and unmasked JSON, and the hashes-after lists: the hold results, VOID rules (rc, PMSET), REST-QUIET and mask-dependent checks for every Sim and Chrome leg
